messages:
Ivy: just rescued Floki from under the couch. he somehow wedged himself into the blanket pocket and refuses to leave. pic: https://imgur.com/a/FlokiCouchTuck :rofl:
Marco: OMG that face. couch burrito levels: expert. :joy:
Jules: this is our new team mascot. can we make a tiny sweater with the company logo? :heart_eyes:
Priya: vote time — react with :one: for 'Floof', :two: for 'Couch Burrito', :three: for 'Slipper Bandit'
Ben: Slipper Bandit forever. also @Ivy put him on the standby list for office naps 😴
Nora: low-key impressed he found a blanket pocket. engineering feat. :nerd_face:
Ivy: snaps-bot uploaded an image: floki_tucked_2026-03-23.jpg (attached)
Marco: can confirm, he also stole my slipper last week. left it under the ficus. :scream:
Jules: petition to make Floki an honorary repo owner. :raised_hands:
Priya: can we get a calendar invite for Floki's weekly nap check-ins? i'll bring treats. :cookie:
Ben: (thumbsup) this thread has restored my faith in the internet for 3 minutes.
Nora: also — if anyone needs a pick-me-up, i have a short video. 6s of very dramatic ear wiggles.
Ivy: will post video on Friday drop. thanks for indulging my chaotic pup moment :dog:
